about: Read by tests/design-css.test.js (rules R1 and V1 of docs/design.md). physicalExceptions: a left or right property that is right on purpose, matched exactly (file, selector or line, property), each with its reason; an entry that no declaration matches any more fails. literalBudget: the count of px and rem literals in spacing, radius and font-size declarations of each file (a size that has a token in src/ui/base.css must be written as the token, so these are the sizes that no token has yet); it may only go down (the test fails above it and below it), and a file that is not listed has 0. Raising a number is the owner's decision.

physicalExceptions.reason: env(safe-area-inset-left) is a physical value (the notch is on a physical side of the screen), so the padding that carries it is physical too: padding-inline-start would put the inset on the wrong side in right-to-left (the comment above it in ui.css says so).

env(safe-area-inset-right) is a physical value (the notch is on a physical side of the screen), so the padding that carries it is physical too: padding-inline-end would put the inset on the wrong side in right-to-left (the comment above it in ui.css says so).

The chevron of a select is a background image at the end of the field. background-position has no logical keyword that Chromium supports (CSS.supports refuses x-end and inline-end there, checked in Chromium 153), so the edge is chosen by direction: left by default (the committee app is right to left), right under [dir='ltr'] on the next rule.

The left-to-right half of the chevron above: the chevron of a select sits at the end of the field, which is the right edge when the page is left to right, and background-position has no logical keyword that Chromium supports.
